title: Marine Air Ground Task Force (MAGTF) Intelligence Planner (I) (LtCol to Maj) NMOS (0202), DIR INTEL
raw_text:
7. MOS 0209, Marine Air Ground Task Force (MAGTF) Intelligence Planner (I)
(LtCol to Maj) NMOS (0202), DIR INTEL

    a. Summary. The MAGTF Intelligence Planner is a field grade Marine
Intelligence Officer that serves at senior level billets as a representative
of the Marine Corps Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance Enterprise
(MCISRE). 0209s integrate practical tactical and operational level
intelligence knowledge and experience within the larger MAGTF, MCISRE, and
Marine Corps operational framework. Within the fleet marine forces/operating
forces and naval components, the MAGTF Intelligence Planner generally serves
on MAGTF and major subordinate command staffs, and is familiar with MAGTF/
MCISRE intelligence structure, processes, and capabilities. The MAGTF
Intelligence Planner can plan intelligence operations and can lead the
intelligence effort for the Marine Corps planning process (MCPP), joint
planning process (JPP), and other service level-processes. Within the
supporting establishment, the MAGTF Intelligence Planner represents the
MCISRE in the generation and employment of intelligence capabilities, and the
integration of MCISRE capabilities within the service and joint, interagency,
intergovernmental, and multinational (JIIM) communities. Within the joint,
coalition, and intelligence community billets, the MAGTF Intelligence Planner
represents Marine Corps intelligences interests and equities. They can
define requirements, develop plans, guidance, policies, and interpret and
apply external plans, guidance, and policies to a command/organization.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Attain selection or promotion to major.

            (2) Complete resident or non-resident Expeditionary Warfare School.

        (3) Completed the Tactical Intelligence Officer Course (TIOC)
(N46CU22), Marine Corps Detachment, Dam Neck, VA.

        (4) Security requirement: must meet sensitive compartmented
information (SCI) eligibility guidelines based on a single scope background
investigation/T5 investigation.

        (5) Complete one of the entry-level Intelligence Courses for the
following NMOSs 0203 (N46HFM2), 0204 (N46HFW2), 0206 (N46CUK2), or 0207
(N460HU2) located at Marine Corps Intelligence Schools, Dam Neck, VA.

    c. Requirements. For the active duty and reserve officers, complete the
MAGTF Intelligence Planners Course (MIPC) (N460JJ2), Marine Corps Detachment,
Dam Neck, VA.


                                          1-13                       Enclosure (1)
 1105                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L



    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to NAVMC
3500.100C, the Intelligence Training and Readiness (T&R) Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Command and Control Center Officers 55-1015.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade.
